meta.name: Commit signed by a path owner
meta.description: Passes when the pull request head commit carries a verified gitsign (sigstore) signature whose identity is one the path owner lists in the signers context value.

signers.description: Sigstore identities (emails) allowed to sign changes under this path. Supplied by the path owner through claim.

issuer.description: OIDC issuer the signer identity must come from. Owned by the repository; owners cannot change it unless ownerContext lists it.

tenets.code: predicates.exists(p, p.verification.verified && p.verification.signers.exists(s, has(s.sigstore) && s.sigstore.issuer == context.issuer && s.sigstore.identity in context.signers))

assessment.message: The commit is signed by an identity the path owner accepts

error.message: The commit is not signed by an identity the path owner accepts
error.guidance: Sign the head commit with gitsign using one of the identities the path owner lists in its claim document.
